context_requirements: Expression of SYK or the off-target kinases RET/ATP5A1/ATP5B/ATP5C1/IRF3
Intact SYK-dependent signaling (e.g., BCR, FcR, integrin, or TLR pathways)
For SYK-dependent effects: hematopoietic or B-cell-like lineage, or SYK-driven malignancy
For RET-dependent effects: RET fusion or activating RET mutation
For mitochondrial ATP synthase effects: high oxidative phosphorylation dependence
falsifiers: No change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Strong, reproducible upregulation of SYK-dependent inflammatory genes (e.g., CCL2, CXCL2, IL1B) at 6 h
No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, MKI67) at 24 h in any line
Selective, strong induction of interferon-stimulated genes at 6 h
Dose-dependent increase in SYK phosphorylation or SYK-dependent calcium flux
